recentItems.title: Attack on Kuibyshev oil depot, HALT of plants and weapons warehouses in Moscow
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian drones have once again struck the Kuibyshev oil refinery in Samara region and completely shut down the Moscow refinery. Defence forces destroyed key bridges on the Huliaipole direction and wiped out a launch base for the occupiers’ jet drones in Oryol region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy began his visit to the US with a meeting with senators, discussing de-escalation, Patriot systems and tougher sanctions. A Ukrainian company has completed trials of the new «Zorelit V5» interceptor drone, capable of destroying high-speed aerial targets of the enemy. Against this backdrop, China has confirmed the first visit by Xi Jinping to the US in 11 years for talks with Donald Trump.

recentItems.title: PSEUDO-ELECTIONS in Russia and in the occupied territories – with BLACKMAIL and MOBILISATION
recentItems.description:
Another round of pseudo-elections has taken place in Russia, already dubbed an electoral farce by international observers and human rights defenders. Mass anomalies, ballot stuffing and refusal to issue paper documents were recorded in many regions of the Russian Federation and in Ukraine’s temporarily occupied territories. According to experts, the «painted» victory of United Russia is needed by the Kremlin to justify further escalation of the war. Right next to polling stations, military commissariats are already issuing summonses and forcing people to sign contracts with the Russian Ministry of Defence. Against the backdrop of losses exceeding one and a half million personnel and a fuel crisis, Russians face a new, covert and digitised wave of mobilisation.

recentItems.title: UN VOICE: TRIBUNAL FOR PUTIN AND PROTECTION FOR UKRAINE! In response, two giant refineries burn
recentItems.description:
The 81st session of the UN General Assembly has begun in New York, where leaders are pressuring the Kremlin, discussing a special tribunal for war criminals, new air defence systems for Ukraine, and an energy ceasefire. In response, Russia struck hundreds of missiles and drones at Kyiv, Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih, Pavlohrad and the Odesa region.
 
Retaliation did not take long: Ukraine’s long-range forces set fire to the Bashneft giant in Ufa and the Kuibyshev refinery in Samara, the «Magyar’s Birds» unit continues to sink Putin’s shadow fleet of tankers in two seas, and the occupiers’ losses on the front line again exceeded 1,000 personnel in a single day!

recentItems.title: Ukrainian UAVs PIERCED 4 RINGS of Russia’s AIR DEFENCE & PARALYSED the Moscow plant in Kapotnya
recentItems.description:
Ukraine’s defenders delivered precise strikes on the occupiers’ supply routes in Zaporizhzhia region, forcing the enemy to switch to less protected motorised equipment. On the eastern front, Ukrainian brigades continue to exhaust the adversary’s forces, ruining its plans to seize key cities of the Donbas. Military expert Ihor Romanenko stressed that the enemy offensive is gradually losing momentum due to an acute shortage of manpower and equipment. A successful special operation by Ukraine’s defence forces deep in Russia’s rear led to a complete shutdown of the strategic oil refinery in Moscow. The pinpoint work of Ukrainian strike assets proved the ability to overcome even the enemy’s most densely layered, echeloned air defence system.

recentItems.title: Russia increases petrol imports 23-fold — even buying fuel from Belarus
recentItems.description:
Ukraine has struck one of Moscow’s key oil refineries, sparking a large fire and damaging several processing units. Kyiv confirmed that the attack involved not only drones but also a Pelikan ballistic missile.
Russia’s fuel crisis is deepening: Moscow has increased petrol imports from Belarus 23-fold amid continued Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries. The United States and the European Union are allocating nearly $6 billion to strengthen Ukraine’s air defence, while Canada is considering joining a €90 billion European lending programme. Zelenskyy and Trump discussed peace, de-escalation, and energy security ahead of their meeting in New York. Ukraine also unveiled a new interceptor that destroyed a Russian Geran-5 jet-powered drone.
